vsm2.13:41.1: Tatopi dīghassa addhuno accayena sattamo sūriyo pātubhavati.
vsm2.13:41.2: Yassa pātubhāvā sakalacakkavāḷaṃ ekajālaṃ hoti saddhiṃ koṭisatasahassacakkavāḷehi.
vsm2.13:41.7: Tattha tayopi brahmaloke jhāpetvā ābhassare āhacca tiṭṭhati.
vsm2.13:41.8: Sā yāva aṇumattampi saṅkhāragataṃ atthi, tāva na nibbāyati.
vsm2.13:41.9: Sabbasaṅkhāraparikkhayā pana sappitelajhāpanaggisikhā viya chārikampi anavasesetvā nibbāyati.
vsm2.13:42.1: Heṭṭhāākāsena saha upariākāso eko hoti mahandhakāro.
vsm2.13:42.2: Atha dīghassa addhuno accayena mahāmegho uṭṭhahitvā paṭhamaṃ sukhumaṃ sukhumaṃ vassati.
vsm2.13:42.3: Anupubbena kumudanāḷayaṭṭhimusalatālakkhandhādippamāṇāhi dhārāhi vassanto koṭisatasahassacakkavāḷesu sabbaṃ daḍḍhaṭṭhānaṃ pūretvā antaradhāyati.
vsm2.13:42.4: Taṃ udakaṃ heṭṭhā ca tiriyañca vāto samuṭṭhahitvā ghanaṃ karoti parivaṭumaṃ paduminipatte udakabindusadisaṃ.
vsm2.13:42.5: Kathaṃ tāva mahantaṃ udakarāsiṃ ghanaṃ karotīti ce?
vsm2.13:42.6: Vivarasampadānato. Tañhissa tamhi tamhi vivaraṃ deti.
vsm2.13:43.1: Taṃ evaṃ vātena sampiṇḍiyamānaṃ ghanaṃ kariyamānaṃ parikkhayamānaṃ anupubbena heṭṭhā otarati.
vsm2.13:43.2: Otiṇṇe otiṇṇe udake brahmalokaṭṭhāne brahmalokā, upari catukāmāvacaradevalokaṭṭhāne ca devalokā pātubhavanti.
vsm2.13:43.4: Te taṃ pihitadvāre dhamakaraṇe ṭhitaudakamiva nirassāsaṃ katvā rundhanti.
vsm2.13:43.5: Madhurodakaṃ parikkhayaṃ gacchamānaṃ upari rasapathaviṃ samuṭṭhāpeti.
vsm2.13:43.6: Sā vaṇṇasampannā ceva hoti gandharasasampannā ca nirudakapāyāsassa upari paṭalaṃ viya.
vsm2.13:44.1: Tadā ca ābhassarabrahmaloke paṭhamatarābhinibbattā sattā āyukkhayā vā puññakkhayā vā tato cavitvā idhūpapajjanti.
vsm2.13:44.3: Te aggaññasutte (dī. ni. 3.119) vuttanayena taṃ rasapathaviṃ sāyitvā taṇhābhibhūtā āluppakārakaṃ paribhuñjituṃ upakkamanti.
vsm2.13:44.4: Atha nesaṃ sayaṃpabhā antaradhāyati, andhakāro hoti.
vsm2.13:45.1: Tato nesaṃ bhayaṃ nāsetvā sūrabhāvaṃ janayantaṃ paripuṇṇapaṇṇāsayojanaṃ sūriyamaṇḍalaṃ pātubhavati,
vsm2.13:45.2: te taṃ disvā ‘‘ālokaṃ paṭilabhimhā’’ti haṭṭhatuṭṭhā hutvā
vsm2.13:45.3: ‘‘amhākaṃ bhītānaṃ bhayaṃ nāsetvā sūrabhāvaṃ janayanto uṭṭhito, tasmā ‘‘sūriyo hotū’’ti sūriyotvevassa nāmaṃ karonti.
vsm2.13:45.4: Atha sūriye divasaṃ ālokaṃ katvā atthaṅgate yampi ālokaṃ labhimhā, sopi no naṭṭhoti puna bhītā honti.
vsm2.13:45.5: Tesaṃ evaṃ hoti ‘‘sādhu vatassa sace aññaṃ ālokaṃ labheyyāmā’’ti.
vsm2.13:46.1: Tesaṃ cittaṃ ñatvā viya ekūnapaṇṇāsayojanaṃ candamaṇḍalaṃ pātubhavati.
vsm2.13:46.2: Te taṃ disvā bhiyyoso mattāya haṭṭhatuṭṭhā hutvā ‘‘amhākaṃ chandaṃ ñatvā viya uṭṭhito, tasmā cando hotū’’ti candotvevassa nāmaṃ karonti.
vsm2.13:47.1: Evaṃ candimasūriyesu pātubhūtesu nakkhattāni tārakarūpāni pātubhavanti.
vsm2.13:47.2: Tato pabhuti rattindivā paññāyanti, anukkamena ca māsaddhamāsautusaṃvaccharā.
vsm2.13:48.2: Te ca kho apubbaṃ acarimaṃ phagguṇapuṇṇamadivaseyeva pātubhavanti.
vsm2.13:48.4: Yathā nāma kaṅgubhatte paccamāne ekappahāreneva pupphuḷakāni uṭṭhahanti. Eke padesā thūpathūpā honti, eke ninnaninnā, eke samasamā.
vsm2.13:48.5: Evamevaṃ thūpathūpaṭṭhāne pabbatā honti, ninnaninnaṭṭhāne samuddā, samasamaṭṭhāne dīpāti.
vsm2.13:49.1: Atha tesaṃ sattānaṃ rasapathaviṃ paribhuñjantānaṃ kamena ekacce vaṇṇavanto, ekacce dubbaṇṇā honti.
vsm2.13:49.5: Atha nesaṃ teneva nayena sopi antaradhāyati.
vsm2.13:49.8: Akaṭṭhapāko sāli pātubhavati akaṇo athuso suddho sugandho taṇḍulapphalo.
vsm2.13:50.2: Te sāliṃ bhājane ṭhapetvā pāsāṇapiṭṭhiyā ṭhapenti, sayameva jālasikhā uṭṭhahitvā taṃ pacati.
vsm2.13:50.3: So hoti odano sumanajātipupphasadiso, na tassa sūpena vā byañjanena vā karaṇīyaṃ atthi.
vsm2.13:50.4: Yaṃ yaṃ rasaṃ bhuñjitukāmā honti, taṃ taṃ rasova hoti.
vsm2.13:51.1: Tesaṃ taṃ oḷārikaṃ āhāraṃ āharayataṃ tato pabhuti muttakarīsaṃ sañjāyati.
vsm2.13:51.2: Atha nesaṃ tassa nikkhamanatthāya vaṇamukhāni pabhijjanti, purisassa purisabhāvo, itthiyāpi itthibhāvo pātubhavati.
vsm2.13:51.3: Tatra sudaṃ itthī purisaṃ, puriso ca itthiṃ ativelaṃ upanijjhāyati.
vsm2.13:52.1: Te asaddhammapaṭisevanapaccayā viññūhi garahiyamānā viheṭhiyamānā tassa asaddhammassa paṭicchādanahetu agārāni karonti.
vsm2.13:52.2: Te agāraṃ ajjhāvasamānā anukkamena aññatarassa alasajātikassa sattassa diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjantā sannidhiṃ karonti.
vsm2.13:52.3: Tato pabhuti kaṇopi thusopi taṇḍulaṃ pariyonandhati, lāyitaṭṭhānampi na paṭivirūhati.
vsm2.13:52.4: Te sannipatitvā anutthunanti ‘‘pāpakā vata bho dhammā sattesu pātubhūtā, mayaṃ hi pubbe manomayā ahumhā’’ti aggaññasutte (dī. ni. 3.128) vuttanayena vitthāretabbaṃ.
vsm2.13:53.2: Atha aññataro satto aññassa bhāgaṃ adinnaṃ ādiyati.
vsm2.13:53.3: Taṃ dvikkhattuṃ paribhāsetvā tatiyavāre pāṇileṭṭudaṇḍehi paharanti.
vsm2.13:53.4: Te evaṃ adinnādānagarahamusāvādadaṇḍādānesu uppannesu sannipatitvā cintayanti
vsm2.13:53.5: ‘‘yaṃnūna mayaṃ ekaṃ sattaṃ sammanneyyāma, yo no sammā khīyitabbaṃ khīyeyya, garahitabbaṃ garaheyya, pabbājetabbaṃ pabbājeyya, mayaṃ panassa sālīnaṃ bhāgaṃ anuppadassāmā’’ti.
vsm2.13:54.1: Evaṃ katasanniṭṭhānesu pana sattesu imasmiṃ tāva kappe ayameva bhagavā bodhisattabhūto tena samayena tesu sattesu abhirūpataro ca dassanīyataro ca mahesakkhataro ca buddhisampanno paṭibalo niggahapaggahaṃ kātuṃ.
vsm2.13:54.5: dhammena samena pare rañjetīti rājāti tīhi nāmehi paññāyittha.
vsm2.13:54.6: Yañhi loke acchariyaṭṭhānaṃ, bodhisattova tattha ādipurisoti
vsm2.13:54.7: evaṃ bodhisattaṃ ādiṃ katvā khattiyamaṇḍale saṇṭhite anupubbena brāhmaṇādayopi vaṇṇā saṇṭhahiṃsu.
vsm2.13:55.1: Tattha kappavināsakamahāmeghato yāva jālupacchedo, idamekaṃ asaṅkhyeyyaṃ saṃvaṭṭoti vuccati.
vsm2.13:55.2: Kappavināsakajālupacchedato yāva koṭisatasahassacakkavāḷaparipūrako sampattimahāmegho, idaṃ dutiyaṃ asaṅkhyeyyaṃ saṃvaṭṭaṭṭhāyīti vuccati.
vsm2.13:55.3: Sampattimahāmeghato yāva candimasūriyapātubhāvo, idaṃ tatiyaṃ asaṅkhyeyyaṃ vivaṭṭoti vuccati.
vsm2.13:55.4: Candimasūriyapātubhāvato yāva puna kappavināsakamahāmegho, idaṃ catutthaṃ asaṅkhyeyyaṃ vivaṭṭaṭṭhāyīti vuccati.
vsm2.13:55.5: Imāni cattāri asaṅkhyeyyāni eko mahākappo hoti.
vsm2.13:55.6: Evaṃ tāva agginā vināso ca saṇṭhahanañca veditabbaṃ.
vsm2.13:56.1: Yasmiṃ pana samaye kappo udakena nassati, āditova kappavināsakamahāmegho uṭṭhahitvāti pubbe vuttanayeneva vitthāretabbaṃ.
vsm2.13:57.1: Ayaṃ pana viseso, yathā tattha dutiyasūriyo, evamidha kappavināsako khārudakamahāmegho vuṭṭhāti.
vsm2.13:57.2: So ādito sukhumaṃ sukhumaṃ vassanto anukkamena mahādhārāhi koṭisatasahassacakkavāḷānaṃ pūrento vassati.
vsm2.13:57.3: Khārudakena phuṭṭhaphuṭṭhā pathavīpabbatādayo vilīyanti, udakaṃ samantato vātehi dhāriyati.
vsm2.13:57.5: Tattha tayopi brahmaloke vilīyāpetvā subhakiṇhe āhacca tiṭṭhati.
vsm2.13:57.6: Taṃ yāva aṇumattampi saṅkhāragataṃ atthi, tāva na vūpasammati.
vsm2.13:57.7: Udakānugataṃ pana sabbasaṅkhāragataṃ abhibhavitvā sahasā vūpasammati antaradhānaṃ gacchati.
vsm2.13:57.8: Heṭṭhāākāsena saha upariākāso eko hoti mahandhakāroti sabbaṃ vuttasadisaṃ.
vsm2.13:57.9: Kevalaṃ panidha ābhassarabrahmalokaṃ ādiṃ katvā loko pātubhavati.
vsm2.13:57.10: Subhakiṇhato ca cavitvā ābhassaraṭṭhānādīsu sattā nibbattanti.
vsm2.13:58.1: Tattha kappavināsakamahāmeghato yāva kappavināsakudakūpacchedo, idamekaṃ asaṅkhyeyyaṃ.
vsm2.13:58.2: Udakūpacchedato yāva sampattimahāmegho, idaṃ dutiyaṃ asaṅkhyeyyaṃ.
vsm2.13:58.3: Sampattimahāmeghato…pe… imāni cattāri asaṅkhyeyyāni eko mahākappo hoti.
vsm2.13:58.4: Evaṃ udakena vināso ca saṇṭhahanañca veditabbaṃ.
vsm2.13:59.1: Yasmiṃ samaye kappo vātena vinassati, āditova kappavināsakamahāmegho uṭṭhahitvāti pubbe vuttanayeneva vitthāretabbaṃ.
vsm2.13:60.1: Ayaṃ pana viseso, yathā tattha dutiyasūriyo, evamidha kappavināsanatthaṃ vāto samuṭṭhāti.
vsm2.13:60.3: Tato saṇharajaṃ sukhumavālikaṃ thūlavālikaṃ sakkharapāsāṇādayoti yāva kūṭāgāramatte pāsāṇe visamaṭṭhāne ṭhitamahārukkhe ca uṭṭhāpeti.
vsm2.13:60.4: Te pathavito nabhamuggatā na ca puna patanti.
vsm2.13:61.1: Athānukkamena heṭṭhā mahāpathaviyā vāto samuṭṭhahitvā pathaviṃ parivattetvā uddhaṃmūlaṃ katvā ākāse khipati.
vsm2.13:61.2: Yojanasatappamāṇāpi pathavippadesā dviyojanatiyojanacatuyojanapañcayojanasatappamāṇāpi bhijjitvā vātavegena khittā ākāseyeva cuṇṇavicuṇṇā hutvā abhāvaṃ gacchanti.
vsm2.13:61.3: Cakkavāḷapabbatampi sinerupabbatampi vāto ukkhipitvā ākāse khipati.
vsm2.13:61.4: Te aññamaññaṃ abhihantvā cuṇṇavicuṇṇā hutvā vinassanti.
vsm2.13:61.5: Eteneva upāyena bhummaṭṭhakavimānāni ca ākāsaṭṭhakavimānāni ca vināsento chakāmāvacaradevaloke vināsetvā koṭisatasahassacakkavāḷāni vināseti.
vsm2.13:61.6: Tattha cakkavāḷā cakkavāḷehi himavantā himavantehi sinerū sinerūhi aññamaññaṃ samāgantvā cuṇṇavicuṇṇā hutvā vinassanti.
vsm2.13:62.2: Tattha tayopi brahmaloke vināsetvā vehapphalaṃ āhacca tiṭṭhati.
vsm2.13:62.4: Heṭṭhāākāsena saha upariākāso eko hoti mahandhakāroti sabbaṃ vuttasadisaṃ.
vsm2.13:62.5: Idha pana subhakiṇhabrahmalokaṃ ādiṃ katvā loko pātubhavati.
vsm2.13:62.6: Vehapphalato ca cavitvā subhakiṇhaṭṭhānādīsu sattā nibbattanti.
vsm2.13:63.1: Tattha kappavināsakamahāmeghato yāva kappavināsakavātūpacchedo, idamekaṃ asaṅkhyeyyaṃ.
vsm2.13:63.2: Vātūpacchedato yāva sampattimahāmegho, idaṃ dutiyaṃ asaṅkhyeyyaṃ…pe… imāni cattāri asaṅkhyeyyāni eko mahākappo hoti.
vsm2.13:63.3: Evaṃ vātena vināso ca saṇṭhahanañca veditabbaṃ.
vsm2.13:64.3: Akusalamūlesu hi ussannesu evaṃ loko vinassati.
vsm2.13:64.4: So ca kho rāge ussannatare agginā vinassati.
vsm2.13:64.6: Keci pana dose ussannatare agginā. Rāge ussannatare udakenāti vadanti.
vsm2.13:65.1: Evaṃ vinassantopi ca nirantarameva sattavāre agginā vinassati. Aṭṭhame vāre udakena.
vsm2.13:65.2: Puna sattavāre agginā. Aṭṭhame vāre udakenāti evaṃ aṭṭhame aṭṭhame vāre vinassanto sattakkhattuṃ udakena vinassitvā puna sattavāre agginā nassati.
vsm2.13:65.4: Etthantare udakena nassanavāraṃ sampattampi paṭibāhitvā laddhokāso vāto paripuṇṇacatusaṭṭhikappāyuke subhakiṇhe viddhaṃsento lokaṃ vināseti.
vsm2.13:66.1: Pubbenivāsaṃ anussarantopi ca kappānussaraṇako bhikkhu etesu kappesu anekepi saṃvaṭṭakappe anekepi vivaṭṭakappe anekepi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe anussarati.
vsm2.13:66.3: Tattha amutrāsinti amumhi saṃvaṭṭakappe ahaṃ amumhi bhave vā yoniyā vā gatiyā vā viññāṇaṭṭhitiyā vā sattāvāse vā sattanikāye vā āsiṃ.
vsm2.13:67.4: Sace pana tasmiṃ kāle attano vaṇṇasampattiṃ vā lūkhapaṇītajīvikabhāvaṃ vā sukhadukkhabahulataṃ vā appāyukadīghāyukabhāvaṃ vā anussaritukāmo hoti, tampi anussaratiyeva.
vsm2.13:68.1: Tattha evaṃvaṇṇoti odāto vā sāmo vā.
vsm2.13:68.3: Evaṃ sukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedīti anekappakārena kāyikacetasikānaṃ sāmisanirāmisādippabhedānaṃ vā sukhadukkhānaṃ paṭisaṃvedī.
vsm2.13:68.4: Evamāyupariyantoti evaṃ vassasataparimāṇāyupariyanto vā caturāsītikappasatasahassāyupariyanto vā.
vsm2.13:69.1: So tato cuto amutra udapādinti sohaṃ tato bhavato yonito gatito viññāṇaṭṭhitito sattāvāsato sattanikāyato vā cuto puna amukasmiṃ nāma bhave yoniyā gatiyā viññāṇaṭṭhitiyā sattāvāse sattanikāye vā udapādiṃ.
vsm2.13:69.2: Tatrāpāsinti atha tatrāpi bhave yoniyā gatiyā viññāṇaṭṭhitiyā sattāvāse sattanikāye vā puna ahosiṃ.
vsm2.13:70.1: Apica yasmā amutrāsinti idaṃ anupubbena ārohantassa yāvadicchakaṃ anussaraṇaṃ.
vsm2.13:70.2: So tato cutoti paṭinivattantassa paccavekkhaṇaṃ, tasmā ‘‘idhūpapanno’’ti imissā idhūpapattiyā anantaramevassa upapattiṭṭhānaṃ sandhāya ‘‘amutra udapādi’’nti idaṃ vuttanti veditabbaṃ.
vsm2.13:70.3: Tatrāpāsinti evamādi panassa tatra imissā upapattiyā anantare upapattiṭṭhāne nāmagottādīnaṃ anussaraṇadassanatthaṃ vuttaṃ.
vsm2.13:70.4: So tato cuto idhūpapannoti svāhaṃ tato anantarūpapattiṭṭhānato cuto idha asukasmiṃ nāma khattiyakule vā brāhmaṇakule vā nibbattoti.
vsm2.13:71.2: Sākāraṃ sauddesanti nāmagottavasena sauddesaṃ, vaṇṇādivasena sākāraṃ.
vsm2.13:71.3: Nāmagottena hi satto tisso kassapoti uddisīyati.
